title: moduleResourceLocation
responsibility: Resolve module resource destinations while preserving revision scope.

inputs.name: moduleResourceLocation.scope
inputs.description: Selected branch and commit; unrelated entity context is discarded.

inputs.name: moduleResourceLocation.module
inputs.description: Identity of the module declaring this resource.

inputs.name: moduleResourceLocation.resource
inputs.description: Resource declaration with an optional existing catalog destination.

outputs.name: moduleResourceLocation
outputs.description: A fresh catalog or module-resource location in the supplied branch and commit.
